arxiv-2101-03359.title: Symmetry-Protected Topological relationship between S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) and S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) × U ⁡ ( 1 ) SU(2)\times{U(1)} in Two Dimension
arxiv-2101-03359.creator: Ning Wang, Qiao Zhuang
arxiv-2101-03359.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ning Wang, Qiao Zhuang. Symmetry-protected topological ( S ​ P ​ T ) \left(SPT\right) phases are gapped short-range entangled states with symmetry G G , which can be systematically described by group cohomology theory. S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) and S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) × U ⁡ ( 1 ) SU(2)\times{U(1)} are considered as the basic groups of Quantum Chromodynamics and Weak-Electromagnetic unification, respectively.

arxiv-2108-01855.title: Probing the nucleosynthetic contribution of low-metallicity, low-mass star companions of CEMP stars Journal: ApJ Based on data collected using HCT/HESP and SUBARU/HDS
arxiv-2108-01855.creator: J. Shejeelammal, Aruna Goswami
arxiv-2108-01855.description: Abstract The observed abundance diversities among the CEMP stars can shed light on the formation and evolution of elements in the early Galaxy. In this work, we present results obtained from a detailed abundance analysis of a sample of seven extrinsic carbon stars.

arxiv-2208-06646.title: Modeling Network-level Traffic Flow Transitions on Sparse Data Conference: Proceedings of the 28th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 14–18, 2022; Washington, DC, USA Proceedings of the 28th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD ’22), Aug
arxiv-2208-06646.creator: Xiaoliang Lei, Hao Mei, Bin Shi, Hua Wei
arxiv-2208-06646.description: Abstract . Modeling how network-level traffic flow changes in the urban environment is useful for decision-making in transportation, public safety and urban planning. The traffic flow system can be viewed as a dynamic process that transits between states ( e.g. , traffic volumes on each road segment) over time.

arxiv-2211-03597.title: Quantum repeaters and teleportation via entangled phase-modulated multimode coherent states
arxiv-2211-03597.creator: R. Goncharov, Alexei D. Kiselev, E. S. Moiseev, E. Samsonov, S. A. Moiseev, F. Kiselev, V. Egorov
arxiv-2211-03597.description: Abstract We present a scheme of quantum repeater that uses entangled multimode coherent states which are obtained by electro-optic modulation of symmetric and antisymmetric Schrödinger cat states. Part of generated entangled frequency modes are sent to a symmetric beam splitter at the central node, while the remaining modes are stored locally in quantum memories.

arxiv-2405-13889.title: The Intrabinary Shock and Companion Star of Redback Pulsar J2215+5135
arxiv-2405-13889.creator: Andrew G. Sullivan, Roger W. Romani
arxiv-2405-13889.description: Abstract PSR J2215+5135 (J2215) is a ‘redback’ spider pulsar, where the intrabinary shock (IBS) wraps around the pulsar rather than the stellar-mass companion. Spider orbital light curves are modulated, dominated by their binary companion thermal emission in the optical bands and by IBS synchrotron emission in the X-rays. We report on new XMM -Newton X-ray and U-band observations of J2215.

arxiv-2412-02018.title: Sensing Few Electrons Floating on Helium with High-Electron-Mobility Transistors
arxiv-2412-02018.creator: M. M. Feldman, G. Fuchs, T. Liu, L. A. D’Imperio, M. D. Henry, E. A. Shaner, S. A. Lyon
arxiv-2412-02018.description: Abstract We report on low-frequency measurements of few electrons floating on superfluid helium using a bespoke cryogenic cascode amplifier circuit built with off-the-shelf GaAs High-Electron-Mobility Transistors (HEMTs). We integrate this circuit with a Charge-Coupled Device (CCD) to transport the electrons on helium and characterize its performance.

arxiv-2507-21887.title: Convergence of complex martingales in supercritical multi-type general branching processes in L q L^{q} for 1 < q ≤ 2 1<q\leq 2
arxiv-2507-21887.creator: Konrad Kolesko and Matthias Meiners and Ivana Tomic
arxiv-2507-21887.description: Abstract . Nerman’s martingale plays a central role in the law of large numbers for both, single- and multi-type, supercritical general branching processes. There are further, complex-valued Nerman-type martingales in the single-type process that figure in the finer fluctuations of these processes.

arxiv-2508-15159.title: Spectrality of Product Sets with a Perturbed Interval Factor
arxiv-2508-15159.creator: Aditya Ramabadran and Johannes van Vliet
arxiv-2508-15159.description: Abstract . A set Ω ⊂ ℝ d \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{d} is said to be spectral if L 2 ​ ( Ω ) L^{2}(\Omega) admits an orthogonal basis of exponentials. While the product of spectral sets is known to be spectral, the converse fails in general.

arxiv-2511-15315.title: Robust Bayesian Optimisation with Unbounded Corruptions
arxiv-2511-15315.creator: Abdelhamid Ezzerg, Ilija Bogunovic, Jeremias Knoblauch
arxiv-2511-15315.description: Abstract {onecolabstract} Bayesian Optimization is critically vulnerable to extreme outliers. Existing provably robust methods typically assume a bounded cumulative corruption budget, which makes them defenseless against even a single corruption of sufficient magnitude. To address this, we introduce a new adversary whose budget is only bounded in the frequency of corruptions, not in their magnitude.

arxiv-2512-09612.title: Rogue Vertical Drafts in the Mesosphere and Lower Thermosphere: Evidence and Implications
arxiv-2512-09612.creator: J. L. Chau 1,∗ , A. Berera 2 , D. Huyghebaert 1
arxiv-2512-09612.description: Abstract Observational evidence of extreme vertical velocities ( | w | ≥ 12.5 |w|\geq 12.5 m/s and at times greater than 50 m/s) in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere (MLT), has emerged in recent years. We refer to these events as Rogue Vertical Drafts (RVDs).

arxiv-2601-04708.title: On the role of weak Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund constants in polynomial approximation by orthogonal bases Journal: …
arxiv-2601-04708.creator: Congpei An, Alvise Sommariva, Marco Vianello
arxiv-2601-04708.description: Abstract We compute numerically the L 2 L^{2} Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund constants of cubature rules, with a special attention to their role in polynomial approximation by orthogonal bases. We test some relevant rules on domains such as the interval, the square, the disk, the triangle, the cube and the sphere.

pmc-10582694.title: Dimensions of reading: a study of the beliefs of language and literature preservice teachers
pmc-10582694.creator: Carolina González Ramírez, Enzo Pescara Vásquez
pmc-10582694.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This study aims to analyze the beliefs that future Language and Literature teachers hold regarding reading. This work is part of a broader research endeavor focused on the reading habits and practices of teachers in training and their role as prospective mediators since the way in which they perceive reading significantly impacts the mediation processes they undertake in their teaching practices to cultivate readers.

pmc-10639165.title: CD8 T cell response and its released cytokine IFN-γ are necessary for lung alveolar epithelial repair during bacterial pneumonia
pmc-10639165.creator: Xiaoying Zhang, Mir Ali, Morgan Alexandra Pantuck, Xiaofeng Yang, Chih-Ru Lin, Karim Bahmed, Beata Kosmider, Ying Tian
pmc-10639165.description: IntroductionAlveolar epithelial regeneration depends on the activity of resident quiescent progenitor cells. Alveolar epithelial type II (AT2) cells are known as the alveolar epithelial progenitor cells. They exit quiescent state, proliferate rapidly in response to injury and differentiate into alveolar epithelial type I (AT1) cells to regenerate the damaged alveolar epithelium.

pmc-10656665.title: Efficacy of Electronic Reminders in Increasing the Enhanced Recovery After Surgery Protocol Use During Major Breast Surgery: Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-10656665.creator: Sumeet Gopwani, Ehab Bahrun, Tanvee Singh, Daniel Popovsky, Joseph Cramer, Xue Geng
pmc-10656665.description: BackgroundEnhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols are patient-centered, evidence-based guidelines for peri-, intra-, and postoperative management of surgical candidates that aim to decrease operative complications and facilitate recovery after surgery. Anesthesia providers can use these protocols to guide decision-making and standardize aspects of their anesthetic plan in the operating room.

pmc-11438204.title: Complex trauma sequelae: Mycobacterium goodii and Priestia endophytica Hardware infection in a patient with Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
pmc-11438204.creator: Andrea L Covington, Filipe M Cerqueira, Jonathan E Pavia, David Reynoso, Ping Ren
pmc-11438204.description: A 26-year-old man with Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, recurrent otitis externa, and chronic otitis media sustained a left lower extremity amputation and open femur fracture with internal hardware fixation after a motor vehicle collision in Arizona. He presented to the emergency department at our institution with severe left leg pain and purulent discharge despite receiving two unidentified antibiotics upon discharge.

pmc-12361338.title: Dose-ranging and further therapeutic evaluation of a bicistronic humanized TrkB-BDNF gene therapy for glaucoma in rodents
pmc-12361338.creator: Andrew Osborne, Tasneem Z Khatib, Michael Whitehead, Terrance Mensah, Sadat Yazdouni, Bart Nieuwenhuis, Zara Ali, Jared Ching, Robert Watt, Naoki Kishi, Naoki Kozono, James R Tribble, Peter S Widdowson, Keith R Martin
pmc-12361338.description: BackgroundGlaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness, characterized by the progressive degeneration of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs). Activation of the Tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB) pathway by mature brain-derived neurotrophic factor (mBDNF) has emerged as a promising neuroprotective strategy, given its critical role in promoting RGC survival in preclinical models.

pmc-13062322.title: Bilateral Sprengel’s Deformity Treated with Bilateral Modified Woodward Procedure: A Case Report
pmc-13062322.creator: Abdulmonem Alsiddiky, Hayfaa Saud Alshaalan, Yazeed Alsehibani, Nouf Alabdulkarim
pmc-13062322.description: Introduction:Sprengel’s deformity (SD) is a rare congenital scapular deformity, characterized by a small, elevated, or malpositioned scapula. Although it is rare, it is considered one of the most common congenital abnormalities of the shoulder in children. The scapula will be highly raised triangularly shaped, anteriorly and medially rotated, with limited scapulothoracic motion.

pmc-13111334.title: Plasma chaperone-mediated autophagy associated protein HSPA8 combined with white matter hyperintensities serves as the predictive marker of early-stage Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-13111334.creator: Xueqin Yan, Chunhua Liang, Yanxing Zhou, Guo Hong, Chengjie Li, Kaisuo Wang, Yaohui Huang, Xiaohua Xiao
pmc-13111334.description: BackgroundThe relationship between plasma chaperone-related autophagy proteins and white matter hyperintensity (WMH) in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) remains unclear.MethodsWe employed 4D-DIA proteomics to identify plasma protein changes, and evaluated the clinical relevance of the chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA)-related protein HSPA8. Additionally, using ITK-SNAP software to assess WMH volume’s role in AD.

pmc-13279001.title: Ex vivo bradykinin as a functional biomarker for angioedema with normal C1-inhibitor
pmc-13279001.creator: Jinguo Chen, J. Joanna Yu, Joseph Chiao, Yunkou Wu, Mark D. Scarupa, Lili Wan, H. Henry Li
pmc-13279001.description: BackgroundBradykinin-mediated angioedema (AE-BK) remains diagnostically challenging particularly in patients with normal C1-inhibitor, where diagnosis primarily relies on clinical criteria. Routine laboratory tests can identify complement deficiency in hereditary angioedema due to C1-inhibitor deficiency (HAE-C1INH) but not directly assess kallikrein-kinin system dysregulation underlying these conditions.

pmc-13521166.title: Navigating the pause—patient experiences with perioperative anticoagulation interruption: a qualitative study
pmc-13521166.creator: Alfonso Tafur, Sally Jensen, Albert Marquez, Steven Greenberg, Barry Wallach, Jean Connors, Jerrold Levy, Marisa Durante, Alexis Preston, James Douketis
pmc-13521166.description: BackgroundPatients on chronic anticoagulation frequently undergo temporary medication interruption for surgical or invasive procedures, yet the patient perspective on this experience remains poorly characterized.ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to identify the concerns, preferences, and unmet needs of patients undergoing perioperative anticoagulation interruption to inform patient-centered care strategies.

pmc-13616697.title: Assessment of nutritional literacy and its association with glycemic control and obesity in type 2 diabetic patients in Bahrain
